en.topic_title: Elderly woman to stand trial under nat. security legislation despite psychosis diagnosis
en.topic_summary:
A 61-year-old woman will go to trial over allegedly displaying seditious publications from her flat, despite being diagnosed with psychosis and delusional disorder after a Hong Kong court requested that she undergo a psychological evaluation earlier this month.
